title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Juicy Peach Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Juicy Peach captures the taste of ripe, sun-blushed Peaches with their natural sweetness and smooth, rounded finish. Every draw offers a mellow, fruity vape that’s light yet flavourful, with a touch of coolness on the exhale. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod pack includes a prefilled 2ml pod linked to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No bottles, no refilling, and no coil swaps. Just attach it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Powered by a dual mesh coil and draw-activated inhale, the pod ensures smooth vapour production and consistent taste. Expect up to 6000 puffs (approx.) of steady performance before replacing with a new Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod.. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
